text: ふたごじま　まで　まだ　ありそうだし…　セキチクに　かえりたいわ

structure.jp: ふたごじま　まで　まだ　ありそうだし…
structure.en: it looks like there's still a way to go to the Seafoam Islands, and so...

structure.jp: セキチクに　かえりたいわ
structure.en: I want to go back to Fuchsia

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そうだ stuck onto the stem of a verb says that is how it looks to the speaker. ありそうだ = 'it looks like there is some distance left'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as a reason for what comes next. ありそうだし = 'it looks like there's still a way to go, so'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. かえりたい = 'I want to go back'.
